definitions: A large increase in crop production in developing countries achieved by the use of artificial fertilizers, pesticides, and high-yield crop varieties.
The period of rapid agricultural advancement and increased food production, primarily in the mid-20th century, through the introduction of new technologies and practices.
examples: The Green Revolution significantly boosted food supply.
Many credit the Green Revolution with preventing widespread famine.
Concerns about the environmental impact of the Green Revolution have been raised.
